properties.link_name: SIBCS - SIN Mainland Interconnection (Sonora Seri/Guaymas to BCS Submarine HVDC Cable)
properties.voltage_and_technology: +/- 300 kV to 400 kV HVDC Bipolar Submarine Cable (~115-150 km subsea) + Overland 400/230 kV Tie
properties.status_in_2025_2039_plans: DEFERRED / NOT INCLUDED IN BINDING 2025-2039 PVIRCE-PAMRNT INVESTMENT SCHEDULE
properties.estimated_timing: Unscheduled (Long-term post-2039 unless federal financing re-instructed; earlier 2018-2023 PRODESEN tenders cancelled/suspended)
properties.import_export_policy: Planned architecture favored directional mainland SIN clean-energy imports & spinning reserve sharing to cut BCS fuel-oil/diesel dispatch, with bi-directional export potential if large solar/CSP develops; because SIBCS remains isolated, Politica de Confiabilidad imposes a 35% planning Reserve Margin (vs 21.3% SIN).
properties.source_reference: PAMRNT 2025-2039 Sec 3.1 p.27 & Fig 3.3.2 p.34 (confirms SIBCS & SIM remain electrically isolated from SIN and SIBC)

properties.link_name: SIBC - SIN Northern Inter-Regional Tie (Mexicali / San Luis Rio Colorado - Puerto Penasco, Sonora)
properties.voltage_and_technology: 400 kV / 500 kV AC + Series Compensation (~285 km Sonora-BC Corridor)
properties.status_in_2025_2039_plans: IN PROGRESS FOR NORTHERN BAJA CALIFORNIA ONLY (Puerto Penasco Solar Hub Ph II-IV to Mexicali) — DOES NOT REACH BCS
properties.import_export_policy: Connects Baja California (SIBC, currently tied only to US WECC/CAISO 230 kV at 600-800 MW) into the mainland SIN grid; stops north of Ensenada/San Quintin without southward extension to BCS.

properties.link_name: Internal Peninsula Corridor Evaluation: SIBCS (Loreto/Constitucion) <-> SIMUL (Santa Rosalia/Mulege)
properties.voltage_and_technology: 115 kV or 230 kV AC Overland Radial (~190 km Loreto-Santa Rosalia mountainous Sierra de la Giganta corridor)
properties.status_in_2025_2039_plans: NOT INSTRUCTED IN 2025-2029 BINDING PLAN; SIMUL UPGRADED LOCALLY VIA MICROGRID/SUBSTATIONS
properties.estimated_timing: Long-term contingency option (post-2030 pending transmission economics)
properties.import_export_policy: PAMRNT p.27 explicitly states SIBCS and SIMUL remain electrically isolated from each other; Santa Rosalia operates an autonomous CENACE control desk with ~36 MW peak served locally.
